scope_amendments.producer: CSharp raw-only owned bytes; digest-before-chunk; max_32MiB; max_1MiB_chunk; no_parse_base64_log_addin_origin_replay
scope_amendments.durability: plan+terminal+resume_cursor before ACK; Bridge+resource durable ACK; restart recovery stream only
scope_amendments.staging: ordered_unique_no_gap_duplicate; exact length digest terminal; origin mapping without wire fields; post-stream scope/binding recheck; scoped result_ref only; no leakage

scope_amendments.storage: DPAPI metadata only; no plaintext/base64/prefix frames in plan or spool
scope_amendments.metadata: v7 version/domain, full owner tuple, raw-row identity, origin UUID/digest, application/json, length<=32MiB, chunk<=1MiB, terminal digest, plan version/cursor/expiry
scope_amendments.send: persist plan+terminal before first send; rehydrate/rehash/strict-validate; deterministic single chunk; base64 memory/wire only; zero
scope_amendments.ack: cursor advances only exact authenticated durable Gateway ACK CAS; lost ACK resends same chunk; never origin
scope_amendments.retention: raw+plan retained through durable completion and ref retention; disconnect retry

decision_freeze.scope_amendment: append-only C39 amendment; C38 green WSS+HTTP; C39 required/not green; C29/C28 locked; WP-12 not accepted; M4 never accepted
decision_freeze.allowed_semantics: authority-owned entitled nonmutating dispatch_payload_recovery with correlated omitted-payload retrieval
decision_freeze.storage: v7 immutable DPAPI-protected exact UTF-8 response bytes; frame prefix excluded; typed digest domain; 32MiB per-record and per-RSID caps; retention/pruning; no logs
